findings.summary: SC-2 states that the gate fails when the plant test script is missing, when a Go unit lacks the tool directive, and passes with no staticcheck or gitleaks on PATH. The diff adds no test for any of these. The only test touched is the plant test, and it never exercises the gitleaks-plant(.) wiring, the missing-script failure, or the VERIFY_IN_PLANT_TEST guard (no test runs a nested gate with the guard unset and sees the plant test recurse). The job 2 verified record (journal line 69) lists no shell check in covered and reports '.sh(9 files): tracked source under no manifest' as uncovered, so the gate never ran these scripts. Under L216 these criteria are unproven by any test.

The recursion guard `[ -z "${VERIFY_IN_PLANT_TEST:-}" ]` skips the plant check silently: if the variable is set in the caller's environment, gitleaks-plant(.) is neither run nor listed in VERIFY_COVERED and nothing is reported as uncovered. The criterion says a skip must never be silent. The same applies to VERIFY_TOOL_MODULE_DIR on line 78, which an ambient value can redirect to another module without any record. Both are documented as test-only, but nothing restricts them to that use.
